description: A March 4, 2021 BHRRC page (S006) reports a Tajik-China Mining and Industrial Company wage protest but does not identify the physical protest date or turnout. It attributes conflicting police-violence accounts and states a private-employer wage grievance, not a separate own-state demand. Targeted Q033–Q034 searches returned other, distinct mining-worker incidents in 2020 and June 2021, but did not locate the cited original that fixes the March report’s event date.
required_followup: Locate the BHRRC-cited original Radio Ozodi report or another contemporaneous report that establishes the event date, location, gathering size and any separate own-state demand. Do not merge the separate May 2020 or June 2021 worker incidents with the March 2021 allegation.

description: Contemporary Azattyq and Radio Ozodi reports (S011–S012) document Mahmurod Odinaev’s November request for permission to hold a food-price protest and a later detention; neither reports that the proposed gathering occurred. The opened U.S. Department of State report (S009) gives a separate official account tying Dec 5 detention charges to an alleged Oct 29 Hissor altercation. The Q026 CrisisWatch staging-host snippet (S010) remains unverified. No physical event or January continuity is evidenced; this is a coverage gap, not a no-occurrence finding.
required_followup: If new contemporary reporting is found, verify whether any crowd actually assembled, its date/size/target, and whether it continued into January before creating a candidate. Do not infer occurrence from the permit request or subsequent detention.
